title: AYE SHAHEEDE KARBALA AYE JAANE PAIGHAMBAR HUSSAIN
body:
Mohsine Deene Musalma'n Khaasa e Daawar Hussain
Maliko Mukhtaare Duniya Shaafa e Mehshar Hussain
Naazisho Fakhre Nabuwat Deen ke Rahbar Hussain
Tashnakaame Karbala aur Saahib-e Kauser Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jisne Sar dekar bachali Aabroo-e Ambiya
Fakhre Kaaba jisne kardi sar zameene Karbala
Jisne tashna halq se kaata hai baatil ka gala
Arshe Aala se bhi oonche the tahe khanjar Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Bebasi thi raahbar aur bekasi thaame thi haath
Aur fughaane Fatima se goonjti thi kaaynaat
Hasrate'n Baali Sakina ki chalee'n thee'n saath saath
Jab chale khaime se Bhai ke Janaze par Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aasma'n larza fisha'n tha kaampti thi ye zami'n
Sabre Ayubi ne sajde me jhukali thi jabi'n
Pher kar mu rorahe the Ambiyao Mursali'n
The Jawa'n Bete ke khu'n me Sar se Paa'n tak tar Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Laasha e Kadiyal Jawa'n par dil ki haalat Al Amaa'n
Ashke khu'n aankho'n se jaari khushk honto'n par fugha'n
Naame Haider leke Moula LaashLe chaliye waha'n
Muntazar hai Maadare Dilgeer khaime par Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar jhukaay chal rahe the peechhe peechhe Ambiya
Thaam kar Dil rorahe the Mustafa 0 Murtaza
Goonjti thi dashto sehra me bukaaye Fatima
La rahe the suwe khaima Laasha e Asghar Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Khalg ko dikhla chuke Khaliq ki Tasweere Jalal
Jhoomte hain ab faras par hoke zakhmon se nidhaal
Aayi Zehra ki Sada Aja zami'n par Mere Lal
Muntazir hai haath phaylaaye TeriMaadar Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala me nahr par soya hai Shere Murtaza
Abid e Bimar tanha Qaidiye touge bala
Hai bhara darbar aur Ahle haram hai berida
Kya kare Kisko pukare Aapki Khwahar Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Berida Aale Muhammad hain rasan basta khade
Daste zalim me chhadi hai aur Lab Mazloom ke
Roke kehti hai ye Zainab Haay Maajaay Mere
Choomte the Aapke Honton ko PaiGhambar Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj zinda'n se nahi'n uthti Sakina ki Fugha'n
Rorahi hain Rone waali ke liye sab Bibiya'n
Godh me Maasum ka Laasha Liye baithi hai Maa
Margayi Qaide sitam me Aapki Dukhtar Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Qalbe Momin Karbala hai baite Haq se kam nahi'n
Zindagi is Gham se hai ye Ghamnahi'n to hamnahi'n
Juz Ghame Ibne Ali Jaweed koi Ghamnahi'n
Likh liya hai hamne apne Qalbe Muztar par Hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye Shaheed-e Karbala aye Jaane PaiGhambar Hussain
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
